# kargo-loki-gateway — Full Reference for AI Agents

## Project

- **Name**: kargo-loki-gateway
- **Language**: Go 1.26
- **Module**: github.com/corewire/kargo-loki-gateway
- **Dependencies**: stdlib only (no external Go modules)
- **Image**: `ghcr.io/corewire/kargo-loki-gateway`
- **Helm chart**: `oci://ghcr.io/corewire/charts/kargo-loki-gateway`
- **Deployed namespace**: `kargo`

## Architecture

```
Kargo UI  ──GET /logs?namespace&pod&container&analysisRun──▶  gateway  ──GET query_range──▶  Loki
                                                                  │
                                                         k8s API (AnalysisRun.status.startedAt)
```

The gateway is a single stateless binary. It holds no state and needs no leader election.

## Source files

### src/config.go
Loads all configuration from environment variables.

```go
type config struct {
    lokiURL        string        // LOKI_URL
    listen         string        // LISTEN_ADDR
    logWindow      time.Duration // LOG_WINDOW
    fallbackWindow time.Duration // FALLBACK_WINDOW
    limit          int           // LIMIT
    lokiTimeout    time.Duration // LOKI_TIMEOUT
    k8sTimeout     time.Duration // K8S_TIMEOUT
    k8sAPI         string        // K8S_API
    lokiUsername   string        // LOKI_USERNAME
    lokiPassword   string        // LOKI_PASSWORD
    lokiBearerToken string       // LOKI_BEARER_TOKEN
    lokiTenantID   string        // LOKI_TENANT_ID
}
```

### src/k8s.go
Reads `/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token` fresh on every call (tokens rotate ~hourly). Queries `apis/argoproj.io/v1alpha1/namespaces/{ns}/analysisruns/{name}` with a separate `K8S_TIMEOUT` context. Returns zero time on any failure (missing, 404, decode error) so the fallback window is used.

Constants: `tokenFile`, `caFile` (SA token and cluster CA paths).

### src/loki.go
Key functions:
- `lokiWindow(ctx, ns, analysisRun)` — looks up AnalysisRun startedAt, returns `(start, end int64)` in nanoseconds
- `queryLoki(ctx, logql, start, end)` — GETs `/loki/api/v1/query_range`, decodes JSON, stable-sorts entries by ts int64, returns newline-joined lines
- Auth headers applied in order: `LOKI_USERNAME`+`LOKI_PASSWORD` (basic) > `LOKI_BEARER_TOKEN` (bearer); `LOKI_TENANT_ID` (X-Scope-OrgID) is independent and combinable

### src/handler.go
- `nameRe = ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$` — all query params validated before use
- `buildQuery(ns, pod, container)` — pod is a post-selector filter, NOT a stream label:
  - `{namespace="ns",container="c"} | pod=~"pod.*"`
  - Without pod: `{namespace="ns"}`
- `handleLogs` — validates params, calls lokiWindow + queryLoki, writes user-friendly body on error/empty

### src/main.go
Wires TLS-aware k8s client (reads cluster CA), creates `app`, registers `GET /healthz` and `GET /logs`, sets `ReadHeaderTimeout: 5s`.

## RBAC

```yaml
ClusterRole: get on argoproj.io/analysisruns
ServiceAccount: kargo-loki-gateway (namespace: kargo)
```

## Helm chart

Chart: `charts/kargo-loki-gateway/`

Key values:
```yaml
image:
  repository: ghcr.io/corewire/kargo-loki-gateway
  tag: ""          # defaults to .Chart.AppVersion
env:
  LOKI_URL: "http://loki-gateway.loki.svc.cluster.local"
  # LOKI_USERNAME / LOKI_PASSWORD for basic auth
  # LOKI_BEARER_TOKEN for bearer
  # LOKI_TENANT_ID for X-Scope-OrgID
rbac:
  create: true     # creates ClusterRole + ClusterRoleBinding
```

## Kargo urlTemplate

```yaml
urlTemplate: >-
  http://kargo-loki-gateway.kargo.svc.cluster.local/logs?namespace=${{ jobNamespace }}&pod=${{ jobName }}&container=${{ container }}&analysisRun=${{ analysisRun }}
```

`jobName` is the k8s Job name (e.g. `91c3c8eb.smoke-test.1`). The pod name is `<jobName>-<hash>`, matched by `| pod=~"<jobName>.*"`.

## Unit tests (src/main_test.go)

| Test | What it verifies |
|---|---|
| TestBuildQuery | LogQL shape for ns/pod/container combos |
| TestNameValidation | nameRe accepts k8s names, rejects injection attempts |
| TestQueryLokiSorted | Out-of-order streams are merged and sorted by ts |
| TestQueryLokiEmpty | Empty result returns `""` |
| TestQueryLokiUpstreamError | Loki 500 returns error |
| TestAnalysisRunStartedAt | Parses startedAt from mock k8s API |
| TestAnalysisRunStartedAtMissing | 404 returns zero time |
| TestHandleLogsNoNamespace | Missing namespace → 400 |
| TestHandleLogsInvalidParam | Injection attempt → 400 |
| TestHandleLogsLokiDown | Loki 503 → 502 with user-friendly body |
| TestHandleLogsEmptyResult | Empty Loki result → 200 with Grafana hint |
| TestHealthz | `/healthz` returns `ok\n` |
| TestQueryLokiBasicAuth | `Authorization: Basic ...` header sent |
| TestQueryLokiBearerToken | `Authorization: Bearer ...` header sent |
| TestQueryLokiTenantID | `X-Scope-OrgID` header sent |
| TestQueryLokiBearerAndTenant | Both headers sent when both configured |
| TestQueryLokiBasicAuthTakesPrecedenceOverBearer | Basic auth wins if both set |

## E2E tests (test/e2e/, Chainsaw v0.2.15)

| Suite | What it tests |
|---|---|
| `healthz/` | `GET /healthz` returns `ok` |
| `validation/` | 400 on missing namespace, 400 on injection attempt |
| `loki-alloy/` | Loki reachable; Alloy has shipped `e2e-infra` logs |
| `analysisrun-log-flow/` | AnalysisRun Job → Alloy → Loki → gateway returns `e2e-marker` lines |
| `loki-auth/` | nginx basic-auth proxy; gateway with LOKI_USERNAME/LOKI_PASSWORD retrieves logs |

## E2E infra (hack/e2e-infra/)

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `setup.sh` | Creates namespace, installs Argo Rollouts, deploys Loki/Alloy/gateway |
| `loki.yaml` | Loki 3.1.1, single-binary, `allow_structured_metadata: true` |
| `alloy.yaml` | Alloy v1.7.5, `loki.source.kubernetes` + `stage.structured_metadata {pod}` |
| `gateway.yaml` | Gateway deployment with `imagePullPolicy: Never` (kind) |

Alloy config moves pod name from label to structured metadata to replicate production:
```alloy
stage.structured_metadata { values = { pod = "pod_name" } }
stage.label_drop { values = ["pod_name"] }
```

## Build commands

```bash
make test       # go test ./... in src/
make build      # go build -o bin/gateway
make lint       # golangci-lint in src/
make helm-lint  # helm lint + helm template
make e2e        # chainsaw test test/e2e/
make e2e-infra  # deploy kind infra (runs setup.sh)
make kind-create / kind-delete / kind-load
make devenv     # ensure kind cluster + tilt up
```

## Known limitations

| # | Issue | Severity |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `limit=5000` silently truncates very chatty runs | low |
| 2 | No graceful shutdown | negligible |
| 3 | k8s lookup runs inside the same `lokiTimeout` context | low (mitigated by separate K8S_TIMEOUT) |
